# The ops API refuses every page. Nobody is reached, so nobody answered nothing: a safe row (rollback) must not run by policy.
# The desk holds the incident for a person and writes no mitigation.
[!exec:jq] skip
[!exec:shasum] skip
isolate
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

incidentinit
incidentfakes
subst home/.incident/config
env HOME=$WORK/home
env INCIDENT_DIR=$WORK/ops
env INCIDENT_MINUTE_SECONDS=1
env INCIDENT_ROUNDS=2
env INCIDENT_ROUND_SECONDS=1

stdin alert.json
exec sh ops/scripts/spool-alert.sh
exec obeereal item add incident watch-1 --title 'Watch' --body-file body.txt
exec obeereal run watch-1 incident --workflow ops/workflow.star
stdout 'item watch-1 finished'

# No page went out, and nothing ran.
! exists pages.log
! exists writes.log
! exists status.log
! exists restores.log
! exists home/.incident/incidents/incident-2/before.json
! exists home/.incident/postmortems/incident-2.md

# The timeline names the failed pages and the handoff.
grep 'the page to primary failed' home/.incident/incidents/incident-2/timeline.tsv
grep 'HANDOFF: nobody could be paged, so the desk did not run rollback' home/.incident/incidents/incident-2/timeline.tsv
! grep 'nobody answered; rollback is safe' home/.incident/incidents/incident-2/timeline.tsv
